about: Social reaction to KING releases, read by hand from public posts (owner, 28 Oct 2026). X: searches run in the owner's logged-in X on 28 Oct 2026 around 12:30 IST, top results only; 'totals' sum every relevant post those searches returned (official @iamsrk/@redchilliesent posts excluded), so they are what our sweep found, not all of X. 'posts' = the most-viewed of them; 'stance' is our reading of each post's text (positive / critical / neutral), not a platform label. Counts are as X displayed them at reading time. 'videos' = X video posts about KING (deep sweep 28 Oct ~15:30 IST: 328 video posts returned; the 90 most-viewed checked by text, the unrelated ones (cricket, politics, other films) dropped). YouTube videos are in data/king-videos.json.
